sentences.text: The documents do not state that anything replaces KFS.
The 2024 KFS for Loans & Advances is repealed by the 2025 withdrawal with effect from 2025-11-28.

The current UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 still define Key Facts Statement (KFS) as a statement of key facts of a loan agreement, in simple and easier to understand language, provided to the borrower in a standardised format.

missing.searched: withdrawal of circulars, KFS for Loans & Advances, and current UCB/Commercial Banks Responsible Business Conduct Directions
